tw: Kron spends ten pence on a pen, then lends the pen to a hen.
twc: Kron 花十便士买了支笔，转手把笔借给了一只母鸡。

tw: Kron cooks a lot of hot pots on top of a rocking yacht.
twc: Kron 在摇晃的游艇顶上煮了好多锅火锅。

tw: Kron says hey to eight grey whales, and they spray him all day.
twc: Kron 跟八头灰鲸打了声招呼，它们喷了他一整天水。
hint: 一声嘿，换来一天的喷泉。

tw: Kron is really sure his silly reel will reel in a real meal.
twc: Kron 真心相信他那根傻鱼竿能钓上一顿大餐。

tw: Remember, Kron is a member of the December snowman club.
twc: 记住，Kron 是十二月雪人俱乐部的会员。
hint: 雪人里唯一的会员不化。

tw: Kron's activity is to give sixty active kitties a cup of tea.
twc: Kron 今天的活动：给六十只好动的小猫每只倒杯茶。

tw: Kron plays chess in a dress with a goose guest who guesses less.
twc: Kron 穿着裙子下国际象棋，对面的鹅客人越猜越少。
hint: 鹅还在猜，Kron 已经将军。

tw: Kron plays Chinese chess on his knees with a cheeky chimp eating cheese.
twc: Kron 跪着下中国象棋，对面的调皮猩猩在啃奶酪。

tw: Kron loves his polka-dot cot a lot, so he sleeps on it in a parking lot.
twc: Kron 太爱他的波点小床了，连在停车场都睡在上面。

tw: Kron tickles a giraffe to make it laugh in a half-full bath.
twc: Kron 挠长颈鹿痒痒，让它在半缸水里笑。

tw: Kron and a big bun have fun on a trampoline in the sun.
twc: Kron 和一个大面包在阳光下的蹦床上玩得超开心。
hint: 开心到落地都要摆造型。

tw: Handsome Kron hands some sand to a small panda, then admires his face.
twc: 帅气的 Kron 递给小熊猫一把沙，然后开始欣赏自己的脸。

tw: Kron bends one knee to see a bee drink sweet tea.
twc: Kron 单膝跪下，看一只蜜蜂喝甜茶。

tw: At night Kron flies a bright white kite that lights up the town.
twc: 晚上 Kron 放了只亮白的风筝，把全镇都照亮了。
hint: 夜里放风筝，要放会发光的。

tw: Kron minds Granny Goose's grandchild, a wild gosling, on a grand piano.
twc: Kron 帮鹅奶奶看孙子，一只野小鹅在三角钢琴上撒欢。
hint: 孙子交给你，钢琴交给它。

tw: Kron races a lion's son, but the cub has won before Kron has begun.
twc: Kron 和狮子的儿子赛跑，Kron 还没起跑小狮子就赢了。
hint: 儿子跑得比爸爸吼得快。

tw: Kron and a kitten listen to a lizard whistle in the mist.
twc: Kron 和小猫在雾里听一只蜥蜴吹口哨。

tw: Kron and David save a paved cave from a vivid raven.
twc: Kron 和戴维从一只花哨的乌鸦手里救下了一座铺路的山洞。

tw: Jim and Kron swim to the rim of the gym's dim pool.
twc: 吉姆和 Kron 游到了健身房昏暗泳池的池边。

tw: Kate skates late with Kron on a plate as big as a gate.
twc: 凯特和 Kron 很晚还在一个大门那么大的盘子上滑冰。
hint: 盘子当冰场，越晚越得意。
